page.content:
Late Jurassic beds of the American West that yield Allosaurus and sauropods.

How Morrison Formation connects

  • Item: Allosaurus — Allosaurus is the abundant large theropod of the Morrison Formation.
  • Item: Stegosaurus — Stegosaurus is a signature plated dinosaur of the Morrison.
  • Weapon: Diplodocus — Diplodocus is a classic Morrison sauropod.
  • Item: Brachiosaurus — Brachiosaurus was described from Morrison rocks of Colorado.

What is Morrison Formation?

The Morrison Formation, from Montana to New Mexico, is the classic Jurassic dinosaur graveyard: Stegosaurus, Allosaurus, Diplodocus, and Brachiosaurus in floodplain mudstones.

Key threads lead to Allosaurus, Stegosaurus, Diplodocus and Brachiosaurus.
